name: Stripe
purpose: Payment processing, subscription billing, Stripe Connect for creator payouts, webhook event handling
authMethod: API key (secret key) + webhook signing secret

name: Supabase
purpose: PostgreSQL database hosting, authentication service, real-time subscriptions, storage buckets, Row Level Security
authMethod: JWT token (service role key for server, anon key for client with RLS)

name: Cloudflare R2
purpose: Object storage for user-uploaded content, signed URL generation, S3-compatible API for programmatic access
endpoints: custom domain URL for public access
authMethod: Access key ID + secret access key (S3-compatible)

name: Solana
purpose: Crypto wallet verification via message signing, SOL transaction recording, on-chain identity verification
authMethod: RPC endpoint access (no auth for public RPC, API key for private RPC)

name: OpenAI
purpose: AI caption generation for uploaded content, content classification, recommendation engine, analytics insights
authMethod: API key (Bearer token in Authorization header)

name: Socket.IO
purpose: WebSocket-based real-time messaging between fans and creators, broadcast to subscribers, notification delivery, presence tracking

name: Nodemailer
purpose: Transactional email delivery for email verification, password reset, notifications, marketing communications

name: Netlify
purpose: Frontend hosting and deployment, serverless functions, CDN, continuous deployment from GitHub
